english: Fine. Take the lead, and try not to die too quickly.
Fine. The crystal can do it. We find a way to recharge it, and the vault should unlock.
Fine. Then, move along. I don't have time for freeloaders.
Fine. There is one matter outstanding, however...
Finish the adventure as quickly as possible!
Fire & Ice Attacks • Creates Static Storms
Fire a barrage of unpoisoned darts.
Fire a cake to boost allies.
Fire a concussive charge to provide an extra boost. Guaranteed to be 100%% safe. Consumes ammunition.
Fire a harpoon at the target. If it hits, you can reel the target in.
Fire a homing shot at your foe.
Fire a jet of goo that cripples enemies.
Fire a magical light source at target location. Bounces off walls and ceilings. Sticks to level surfaces. Does not require ammunition.
Fire a shot that bleeds your target.
Fire a shot that explodes on impact.
Fire a shot with black powder, creating a smoke cloud that blinds nearby foes.
Fire a tracer, and take aim.
Fire an arc of electricity at your foe.
Fire an attractor pulse at your target. If your target is mechanical, the skill creates a strong force of attraction that pulls you in.
Fire grapeshot to bleed foes (Damage and Double Bleeds)
Fire healing shells at the target location that also provide med kits for soldiers on the front.
Fire imps are attacking the mosshearts! Someone, please help!
Fire made other spirits sad, and Koda was not pleased. He demanded that we guide the spirit, teach it where to go.
Fire the experimental gun creating a teleporter. Warning Experimental!!!
Fire warms, but fire also burns.
Fire! We'll show these land lubbin' cowards how it's done!
Fires Flame Bolts • Summons Altars and Minions
Fires a projectile of weaponized sulfur that explodes on impact, knocking the target down. Applies Sulfur Cloud, increasing damage taken if the target is Forged.
Fires a shock wave forward that can hit multiple times.
Fires up to 5 arrows near the target foe.
Firing cannons is all about precision, timing, and patience. Think you've got what it takes?
First it was the Luxons, the Kurzicks... Now tengu live beside us as if they are equal. Is this what Cantha has become?
translate: Сначала были Luxons, Kurzicks... Теперь tengu живут рядом с нами, как будто они равны. Это то, во что превратилась Cantha?

english: First the Pale Tree, now this.
First things first. We've got a mission assignment. Are you up for it, Initiate?
translate: Сначала о главном. У нас есть задание. Ты готов к нему, Посвященный?

english: First, we'll get you outfitted with one of the chief's modified Mordrem detectors.
Fish are the lifeblood of our bearkin, and our days are centered on the river.
Fish needs to be deboned and gutted.
Fitting, then, that they will burn.
Fix the Mechanism to Open the Gate
Fixates • Sentinel Retribution • Immune to Blind
Fixx has riled up the local hylek again. I warned him about crossing the line between research and petty theft.
Flame Legion huh? What can I do?
Flame Legion in the barracks! Kill!
Flame Legion shamans, soldiers, and sissies are attacking the wrecking yard! We gotta kick 'em back where they came from!
Flame Legion? Are they around here?
Flame Legion? Are they in the vicinity?
Flame Legion? You see them often?
Flame of Koda! Bestow warmth upon this hero!
Flames, no. I don't like the Brand itself. I like the monsters. It happened, now we deal with it, and the job's a pleasure. Life's too short not to enjoy what you do.
Flawless plan, boss. The base is secure. You got anything new in mind?
Fleeing with your tail between your legs?
Flies and maggots have started eating the corpse. No other scavengers can get to the body because of the Mordrem presence.
Flip to the table of contents.
Floating here is a semisolid filament of crackling, humming, radiant energy.
Fluffy little creatures, eager to discover the world.
Focus on her tail. It'll stop the bubbles.
Focus on the fight! Unless you want find your head at great distance from your body. Carried away in the jaws of a wolf, for instance.
Focus on the fundamentals out there. And don't start unless you can finish!
Focus your attention on the vinewrath knights! If we kill them all, we'll finally have a foothold!
Focus your senses and see beyond the mundane world.
Focus, here. He's been using Snaff's research, and I intend to stop him.
Focused on getting their hateful message out. Use control skills to hush them up!
Foggy Forest Homestead Sky already unlocked.
translate: Небо усадьбы Туманного Леса уже открыто.

english: Follow Logan and Rytlock into the Eastern Transept.
Follow Redeemer Kossan on his patrol.
Follow me, comrades. Together, we will strike down the intruders!
Follow me. We'll confront Adelbern at the Foefire's heart.
Follow the group into the cave.
Follow the tracks and look for survivors.
Following Li Ha-Eung's arrest in association with the Purists, who will be the next Minister of Security?
Following the arrest of Minister Li, MinTel continues to dig up a long history of Purist interference in our Ministries.
Foo! Quaggan knows, but Varanos Najirroo said not to tell, to bring you to her as soon as you arrived. Follow quaggan, and quaggan will take to you the village for answers.
Foo. Quaggan's home waters were taken over by dragon ice. It makes quaggan sad, but quaggan's just one of many that had to flee. It's good they have Lashoosh to come to, but quaggan worries.
Food and medicine are hidden in caches out in the desert.
Food is scarce these days, thanks to the centaurs, and fruit is practically a luxury. We're happy to be able to provide these succulent melons at the farmers market.
Fools rush in, they say. No, we'll wait.
Fools! We were fools to fly so close to the Pact fleet.
Fools! You've let her slip her bonds!
Fools. You will never defeat Lord Gaheron!
For all your life, you've been trying to solve a puzzle while only seeing a small fraction of it.
For centuries, maybe even millennia, dolyaks have come to this place to die at the end of their natural life cycle. The air vibrates with energy.
For each bog body in the swarm, the queen takes less damage and deals more.
For everything there's a place and time. Here and now is neither.
For hundreds of years we have hidden in plain sight, living in your cities, manipulating your politics.
For now the smartest thing is to get back inside the city.
For now, I've set up a makeshift lab for experimentation here at the mine. It's humble, but rather quaint, if I do say.
For now, the ministry is urging everyone to report any and all suspicious activity to your local MinSec office.
For now, the wind whispers down crumbling hallways, speaking secrets to those who dare to listen.
For the Crossing! We can't let those centaur scum take what's ours!
For the love of—Recruit! Talk some sense into this woman. She's more stubborn than a goat shaman.
translate: Ради всего святого — новобранец! Вразумите эту женщину! Она упрямее козьего шамана.

english:
For the men who lived to guard us all
They stood defiant atop the wall
For the millionth time, I am Farley Wallin, appointed by both Commander Samuelsson and Queen Jennah to be the human cultural ambassador for Dragon Bash.
For the moment. I used to work with pack animals, training them not to be spooked by gunfire and cannon-fire. But hounds are better. A marmox is useful, but a dog's a comrade.
For too long we have remained apart from the world, protective, afraid to engage with others.
For you fresh troops, we have to take that temple.
For you? The sword would be for Logan.
For your safety, only one beast may be challenged at a time. There is no honor in entering a fight you have no hope of winning.
Forces from Foewatch Encampment and Splintercrest Fort are assaulting Sootpan Kraal.
Foreman thinks he's so big. Look at 'im. Probably just got his job from some relative.

Forged are flowing in from the Desolation. They've ransacked the palace, taken over the mines and the foundry, and wiped out many Awakened. We're helpless without them. I hope we can put things in order before the king's return. Praise Joko.
Forged cannonades must be destroyed in: %str1%
Forged raiders! They're after the skimmers' feed.
Forged realm portals have been spotted near the Ruptured Heart.
Forget Vallog. We should just kill these whiners.
Forgive him, Mother. We were both...too young...
Forgive me for not bowing in awe, but I've known many soldiers who'd boast the same. Can't fault you for your enthusiasm, I guess. You've got spirit. Just don't get yourself killed.
Forgive me if I seem distracted. One of my handmaidens is ill.
Forgive me, but...is there anyone waiting for you back home in Lion's Arch?
translate: Простите, но... ждет ли вас кто-нибудь дома в Lion's Arch?

english: Form a protective shelter for allies.
Form up and listen up. They aren't expecting us to come through this wall.
Forrajeador[f:"Forrajeadora"] de End of Dragons del día
Fort Cadence is under Risen control. Vigil forces are preparing to liberate the fort.

Fort Salma is charged with the forward defense of Queensdale. We have constant skirmishes with the centaurs of the Greyhoof and Wallwatcher camps. At times it seems like this war will never end, but we stay vigilant. Some day, with the help of citizens like you, we will finally crack the centaur offensive and be rid of them for good.
Fort Trinity shall never fall to Risen. Not as long as the Priory, Vigil, and Order of Whispers stand together.
Fortunately, our allies sent help: Agent Zrii from the Order of Whispers, and Crusader Afanen from the Vigil.
translate: К счастью, наши союзники прислали помощь: Agent Zrii из Orders of Whispers и Crusader Afanen из Vigil.

english: Fortune must have called you here.
